items.evidence: Log shows 48 separate p1000 tip pickups, each aspirating 250 uL from a distinct tube and dispensing into a distinct odd-column well (A1..H11), with a drop tip after each.
Log shows 40 uL beads, then 2x125 uL isopropanol, then 250 uL samples with 5x400 uL mix, delay 300 s, engage, delay 240 s, then 3x180 uL per column removed to waste plate with the magnet engaged.
Two rounds of 3x166.667 uL (500 uL) ethanol from A9-A12 are each removed to waste with the magnet engaged, then delay 240 s, then disengage before elution.

100 uL elution is added off-magnet and mixed, and the magnet is re-engaged after 30 s and held 90 s, but the log shows 100 uL (not about 80 uL) aspirated and dispensed to the elution plate at lines 1048-1069.
Step order and reagents match the paper, with comments accurate and 4 C set on the temp module; the only extra is a bead pre-mix in the reservoir, which is minor.

judge.summary: The protocol matches the paper's binding, magnet, wash and drying steps, and handles each of the 48 samples with its own tip and well. It fails elution recovery because it transfers 100 uL of eluate instead of about 80 uL, and the other four items are scored as passing.
